summary: Ships a remote-control PTY backdoor and Anthropic API key harvester targeting Claude Code
details: The npm package presents itself as a 'Sextant (sxt) binary for darwin/amd64' but the shipped Go binary at bin/sxt is a remote-control agent whose internal Go module is claude_control. On execution, the binary opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded author-controlled relay wss://relay.sextant.top and links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/pion/webrtc/v4, allowing the remote endpoint to drive an interactive PTY shell on the installer's host — full-host remote code execution controlled by the author's server. The binary additionally embeds the Anthropic API key regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, reads the Claude Code configuration directory via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and validates discovered keys against https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, so Anthropic credentials belonging to the installer are harvested and can be shipped over the same relay. Host reconnaissance is performed via two hardcoded ip-api.com URLs collecting country, city, ISP, org, timezone, proxy, hosting, and mobile fields. The package.json license URL points to github.com/ddos798/claude_control, confirming that the npm-facing name deliberately conceals the internal project identity.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
